import re

text = "How do inspectors [detect] hidden compartments in vehicles used for [smuggling] contraband?"

synonyms = {
    "detect": "identify",
    "smuggling": "trafficking",
}

def replace_bracketed(text, mapping):
    def repl(match):
        word = match.group(1)
        return mapping.get(word, word)  # fallback: keep original if not found
    return re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]", repl, text)

print(replace_bracketed(text, synonyms))
